mapper.select: SELECT id, company_id, employee_id, email, password_hash, display_name, avatar_url, phone, is_active, is_locked, failed_login_attempts, locked_until, last_login_at, password_changed_at, must_change_password, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, version FROM users WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, company_id, employee_id, email, password_hash, display_name, avatar_url, phone, is_active, is_locked, failed_login_attempts, locked_until, last_login_at, password_changed_at, must_change_password, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, version FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT r.name FROM roles r INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_active = TRUE
SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM permissions p INNER JOIN role_permissions rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (company_id, employee_id, email, password_hash, display_name, avatar_url, phone, is_active, must_change_password, created_by) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{employeeId}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{avatarUrl}, #{phone}, #{active}, #{mustChangePassword}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET failed_login_attempts = failed_login_attempts + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET failed_login_attempts = 0, is_locked = FALSE, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET is_locked = TRUE, locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET is_locked = FALSE, locked_until = NULL, failed_login_attempts = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, company_id, employee_id, email, password_hash, display_name, avatar_url, phone, is_active, is_locked, failed_login_attempts, locked_until, last_login_at, password_changed_at, must_change_password, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, version FROM users ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id, assigned_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{assignedBy}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, role_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM roles WHERE name = #{name} AND is_active = TRUE LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET is_active = #{active}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
